records.text: Lady Vashj, the Coilfang Matron, is a Highborne who says her people must reclaim their rightful place. She calls water scarce in Outland and declares that her people alone should control it. A lieutenant of Lord Illidan, she praises him in battle and speaks with contempt for surface dwellers and outsiders; she says she would rather not engage them, but they leave her little choice.
Morogrim Tidewalker is a commanding deep-water adversary. He invokes the tides and flood of the deep, commands his subjects to attack, and threatens that there is nowhere to hide.

Fathom-Lord Karathress commands guards to confront visitors and calls on them to lend him their strength. He welcomes the power and knowledge he gains, boasting that he is more powerful than ever, then scorns his foes as land-dwelling scum. His words show a leader who treats his guards' aid as a source of personal power and meets intruders with contempt.
Leotheras's speech alternates between a demon claiming control over an elf and a voice that insists it is master yet cannot contain him. A dying voice threatens to return.

Hydross, called the Duke of Currents, shifts between clean and corrupted states: he welcomes the clean change, then cries that poison is taking hold. His words suggest this condition is forced upon him; when he dies in the clean state, he calls himself released.
Vashj'ir Honor Guards speak of unfinished work and say Lady Vashj expects it completed soon. In combat, they can become enraged and use Mortal Cleave.
Coilfang Priestesses can be drawn into a brief exchange, asking what is on someone's mind and agreeing as if sharing a thought. They also use Holy Smite in combat.
A Coilfang beast-tamer who fights with Throw, Cleave, and Bestial Wrath.
Tidewalker Depth-Seers support injured allies by casting Healing Touch when a friendly unit is missing health.
A Tidewalker Warrior uses Bloodthirst in combat, marking it out from the Tidewalker spellcasters and harpooners.
A Tidewalker Shaman. In combat it casts Lightning Bolt, giving this shaman a direct offensive role among the Tidewalkers.
A Tidewalker Harpooner found in area 3607. Its combat routine uses Throw, distinguishing this weapon-wielding Tidewalker from the warriors and spellcasters.
A Tidewalker Hydromancer found in area 3607. In combat it casts FrostBolt, identifying its water-magic role among the Tidewalkers.
A Greyheart Tidecaller present in area 3607. Its combat routine uses Poison Shield, distinguishing its fighting style from the nearby Tidewalker warriors and casters.
A Greyheart Nether-Mage found in area 3607. Its recorded routine randomizes an event phase on aggro, giving it a distinct combat behavior among the Greyheart.
A Greyheart shield-bearer, this naga fights with a shield, hurling it with Avenger's Shield and charging with it in close combat.
A Greyheart skulker, this naga fights with two weapons and interrupts a casting foe with a kick.
A sporebat found in Serpentshrine, this creature attacks with a sonic charge.
The Underbog Colossus is a hulking creature of the Underbog whose combat includes Spore Quake.
A Greyheart technician, this naga belongs to the area's Greyheart ranks and can hamstring an opponent in combat.

A Coilfang serpentguard, this naga speaks with the resolve of a disciplined guard: “We will not fail” and “Understood.” In combat it uses Spell Reflection and a Corrupt Devotion Aura. The brief lines suggest duty and obedience.
A Coilfang Fathom-Witch warns of intruders and voices a duty not to fail its master. In combat, it uses Domination.
A Coilfang Shatterer answers an addressed superior with brief, deferential agreement, including “Yessir.” It fights by casting Shatter Armor.
A Coilfang Hate-Screamer is a combatant that uses Silence.
The Coilfang Frenzy Corpse is the corpse of a Coilfang Frenzy.
A Greyheart Spellbinder fights with Mind Blast.
A Serpentshrine Lurker is a creature that uses Rancid Mushroom in combat.
Fathom-Guard Caribdis is an individually named elite combatant with a dedicated encounter role.
Fathom-Guard Tidalvess is an individually named elite combatant with a dedicated encounter role.
Fathom-Guard Sharkkis is an individually named elite combatant with a dedicated encounter role.

Seer Olum is an Ashtongue ally of Akama, devoted to their plan against Illidan. After Vashj's followers discover and torture him, he fears Illidan will force the secret from him; meditation has helped him endure pain without betraying it. Believing his usefulness to the cause has ended, Olum resolves to enter the spirit world and entrusts Akama to guide their people.

place_records.text: You are in Serpentshrine Cavern, a Coilfang cavern in Zangarmarsh. Lady Vashj, the Coilfang Matron, says her people must reclaim their rightful place and alone should control the scarce water of Outland. Fathom-Lord Karathress commands guards to confront visitors, Morogrim Tidewalker commands his subjects to attack, and Hydross the Unstable, the Duke of Currents, shifts between clean and corrupted states. Among those here are Coilfang serpentguards and Greyheart tidecallers.
